Chapter 367: Chapter 19: Demon Ancestral Tree, Eclipse (Please Subscribe)

“`

“You all came so early?”

Lin Yuan also reached out with his consciousness, arriving outside the Tianqing World, merging with those few descending consciousnesses.

The projection of Lin Yuan’s consciousness was a black ancient tree, while the other three consciousness projections were a massive snake, a pale green lake, and a huge eyeball.

The Outer Void is vast and boundless, of course, it wasn’t home to only the Ancestral Demon Tree as a Foreign Evil God.

These three consciousness projections were precisely from three other Foreign Evil Gods.

...

Between Foreign Evil Gods, encounters didn’t necessarily lead to slaughter, cooperation was also possible.

For instance, Lin Yuan and these three Foreign Evil Gods usually maintained a good relationship, occasionally exchanging or trading information.

Over the past three hundred years, aside from cultivating, Lin Yuan had attempted to befriend those Foreign Evil Gods.

According to what he understood over the years, Lin Yuan learned that deep within the Outer Void, there was a ‘congregation ground’ where a great number of Foreign Evil Gods resided steadily.

The ruler there was also a Foreign Evil God, rumored to have grown into the Ninth Stage.

The growth of Foreign Evil Gods was in stages, for example, Lin Yuan was currently at the Seventh Stage, and the previous Ancestral Demon Tree was also strictly at the Seventh Stage in a strict sense.

As for the Ninth Stage… even though the growth stages of an Evil God were not linked to their strength, how weak could an Evil God who had reached such a stage be?

It’s known that for an Evil God like the Ancestral Demon Tree, the growth limit is the Eighth Stage.

The Ninth Stage… Even with Lin Yuan’s Against-Heaven’s Understanding, he could not glean a shred of useful information.

Based on Lin Yuan’s speculations, a Foreign Evil God at the Ninth Stage, even if not quite a Supreme Being from the Main World, probably wasn’t far behind.

“The gathering ground of Foreign Evil Gods…”

Lin Yuan sighed. If possible, he really wanted to visit,

only the information obtained from other Foreign Evil Gods told him,

to go from Tianqing World to that gathering place,

the time needed would be counted in tens of thousands of years, if not thousands.

Of course, for a Foreign Evil God with almost no end to their lifespan,

tens of thousands of years were nothing more than a few sleeps, but in Lin Yuan’s view, it was entirely unnecessary.

Because the residence time simply wasn’t enough.

“I wonder what a Foreign Evil God at the Ninth Stage would look like? Could it possibly be observed?”

Lin Yuan was somewhat curious.

Foreign Evil Gods are very special beings, their growth stages completely different from the normal cultivation systems.

For example, if Lin Yuan were to grow the Ancestral Demon Tree to the Eighth Stage, perhaps his very existence would be ‘conceptualized’?

“Demon Brother, we’re actually envious of you for being able to occupy a world like this as a place for cultivation…”

As Lin Yuan was deep in thought, the massive snake projection transmitted a mental fluctuation.

The consciousnesses of the other two Foreign Evil Gods also showed longing in their demeanor.

However, they could only envy and yearn, as with the Ancestral Demon Tree that Lin Yuan was, the Tianqing World’s defenses were nearly perfect.

Even if ten-odd Foreign Evil Gods came, they might not necessarily break through the world’s barrier.

And for ten-odd Foreign Evil Gods to join forces, it was harder than reaching the heavens,

most importantly, even if they broke through the Tianqing World, a single world could hardly satisfy the appetites of ten-odd Foreign Evil Gods.

“Alright.”

“Enough with the idle talk, let’s start the trade.”

The massive eyeball Evil God projection emitted a mental fluctuation as a reminder.

The three Foreign Evil Gods had allowed their consciousnesses to descend here for the sole purpose of trading with Lin Yuan.

Most of the time, Foreign Evil Gods wandered through the vast void, occasionally obtaining some treasures.

“Same as always.”

“I only want Sins Water and secret techniques related to World’s Consciousness.”

Lin Yuan nodded, and with a flicker of his thoughts, several azure Demon Seeds appeared in front of him.

The Demon Seeds condensed by the Ancestral Demon Tree, aside from being a weapon against enemies, could be used as a treasure that offered substantial benefits to other Evil Gods once the life imprints inside were reclaimed.

Over the years, Lin Yuan had truly earned a considerable fortune through these Demon Seeds.

Of course, these Demon Seeds referred to the ones perfected by Lin Yuan’s ‘parasitic’ methods.

Every time he condensed such a Demon Seed, Lin Yuan had to expend some time and effort.

And the Demon Seeds whose life imprints had been reclaimed didn’t take up a ‘parasitic’ slot of Lin Yuan’s.

That was why Lin Yuan exchanged them this way.

“No problem.”

“Here are ten portions of Sins Water.”

The lake consciousness projection brought out the collected Sins Water.

Exchanging twenty portions of Demon Seeds with Lin Yuan.

Sins Water, a treasure produced within certain secret realms of the Outer Void,

contained infinite sins and was ideally suited as a nourishing supplement for some Foreign Evil Gods.

After several experiments by Lin Yuan, he found that Sins Water had a not insignificant beneficial effect on the body of the Ancestral Demon Tree.

That was precisely why.

Lin Yuan took the initiative to trade for Sins Water.

While it was true that whether the Ancestral Demon Tree in this World was strong or not made virtually no difference to Lin Yuan’s main body in the Main World,

that was on the premise that Tianqing World’s Origin Source needed to be used to bear the Martial Path Evolutionary Path. If the base strength of the Ancestral Demon Tree could be raised, then of course it would be even better.

“I have two secret techniques related to World’s Consciousness… I’d appreciate it if Demon Brother would take a look…” the giant snake consciousness projection sent out a mental fluctuation.

Sending the beginnings of the two secret techniques related to World’s Consciousness to Lin Yuan.
